description: Risk model used by the Sunhaven Identity Threat and Attack-Path Simulator to calculate scenario risk from likelihood and impact.

likelihoodLevels.label: Rare
likelihoodLevels.description: The threat is unlikely to occur under normal conditions.

likelihoodLevels.label: Unlikely
likelihoodLevels.description: The threat could occur but is not expected frequently.

likelihoodLevels.label: Possible
likelihoodLevels.description: The threat could reasonably occur in the environment.

likelihoodLevels.label: Likely
likelihoodLevels.description: The threat has a strong possibility of occurring.

likelihoodLevels.label: Almost Certain
likelihoodLevels.description: The threat is expected to occur frequently or under common conditions.

impactLevels.label: Minor
impactLevels.description: Limited impact that can be handled with normal operational processes.

impactLevels.label: Moderate
impactLevels.description: Noticeable security or operational impact requiring investigation.

impactLevels.label: Major
impactLevels.description: Serious impact involving important systems, identities or information.

impactLevels.label: Severe
impactLevels.description: Very serious impact involving sensitive information, privileged access or major system exposure.
